children: Bike24 Holding AG raised 2026 revenue guidance to €345M–€360M from €316M–€332M and now expects adjusted EBITDA within €16M–€18M, still inside the prior €16M–€20M range.
Up from €316M–€332M; signals stronger demand and potential topline acceleration.
Narrows to low end of prior €16M–€20M; growth prioritised over margin.
Geographic mix shift boosts sales but pressures earnings near term.
Price sensitivity, electronics mix and transport costs weigh on profit.
This is a mid-cycle guidance raise highlighting demand momentum but margin constraints. A beat on EBITDA or signs of margin recovery alongside growth would turn this into a stronger catalyst.
